_comment: Design step 6 (the step-3 'two Spiteful Slivers + Reckoner, a Sliver beats the face' scenario, moved
here). A settled Boros Reckoner carrying Guilty Conscience attacks for 3 (9 -> 6); GC deals 3 back, the
Reckoner dies and its last-known reflection of 3 is a CHOICE made inside combat (step 5b's combat fan).
Aimed at the face it leaves the opponent at 3. Aimed at a summoning-sick Spiteful Sliver -- an AMPLIFIER,
mult 2 (design 4.1): two Spiteful Slivers grant it two instances -- the Sliver dies to the 3 and still
reflects 3 twice (LKI): 6 -> 0. Only that choice wins turn 4; the face line wins turn 5 (the Slivers
attack). resume_at main1: the fixture starts INSIDE turn 4's first main, so no untap step clears the
Slivers' summoning sickness (without it a new-turn entry would let them attack).
